lines.master:
"On Friday morning, as I cleaned the new piece, I knew at once that something was wrong.
It was far too light, and the old crack had vanished.
I told Director Sofia, but she said, 'You are tired, Livia.'
So at midnight, I switched off the lights and carried the piece out.
It was a copy. I did not want people to call a copy real.
I left my cards so that you could uncover the truth with your own eyes."
